// diagnostic

E-SUBJECT-CALL-ARITY

A bare member chain cannot supply a {arity}-parameter callable here

What

A bare member chain cannot supply a {arity}-parameter callable here

Why

Lower-case `.member` shorthand supplies exactly one subject; a callable with {arity} parameters needs all parameters named

Fix

Write the full lambda, for example `(first, second) -> first{chain}`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-SUBJECT-CALL-ARITY: tests/ui/bare_member_callable_arity.stderr.

Error [E-SUBJECT-CALL-ARITY]: A bare member chain cannot supply a 2-parameter callable here
  --> tests/ui/bare_member_callable_arity.jet:3:26
    |
  3 |     _ :: orders.fold(0, .something)
    |                          ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: lower-case `.member` shorthand supplies exactly one subject; a callable with 2 parameters needs all parameters named
 Fix: write the full lambda, for example `(first, second) -> first.something`
